project.title: 5PIC3 live at Fulfillment Music Center
project.description: An audio-reactive visual system performed live: real-time feedback between sound, code and projection.
project.introText: An audio-reactive visual set performed live as 5PIC3 at Fulfillment Music Center, written in Hydra Video Synth in real time.

gridImages.caption: The set opens with the code alone on the wall.
Mid-set: audio-reactive patterns fill the wall while the code, reading the music's frequency bands, stays on screen above the performers.
Stretched color bands near the end of the set.

project.middleText: As is usual in live coding, the code was projected together with the visuals, so the room could watch the patches being typed, changed and broken as the music moved.
project.highlightCaption: The projection across the wall of the venue.
project.context: Live set as 5PIC3, Fulfillment Music Center

summary.brief: A real-time audiovisual system for a live music event.
summary.method: Algorithmic, audio-reactive Hydra patches driven by the music's frequency bands, with the code projected alongside the output.

project.shows: The same openness in performance: the code projected beside the visuals, so the audience can see how every change is made.
project.embedCaption: The full set, recorded at Fulfillment Music Center (Odysee).

decisions.choice: Project the code alongside the visuals.
decisions.why: So the room could watch the patches being typed, changed and broken as the music moved.
decisions.result: Nothing about how the visuals are made is hidden: the audience reads the system while it runs.
